Metrics: 'Limited to 10k active series per month', '14 days retention'. Logs: 'Limited to 50 GB ingested per month', '14 day retention'.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: 50 GB of logs a month with 14-day retention is the largest free log store found by two orders of magnitude, and it pairs with any free compute tier as the place a crawler writes its errors instead of a paid service.

limits.value: 10,000 active series is the stop for metrics: a sidecar-heavy Kubernetes stack reports 50,000 or more, and cardinality is counted per active series per month, so one label with unbounded values exhausts it.

free plan includes 'All Grafana Cloud services, with usage limits', 'Adaptive Telemetry, AI Assistant' and '14 days retention for metrics, logs, traces, profiles, & k6 performance tests'

notes: The free plan covers hosted Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope and k6, so one account yields a metrics store, a log store and a load tester. Retention of 14 days means this is an observation window, not a data store. Traces, profiles and k6 limits are stated on the page per product and were not all read; only the metrics and logs figures above are verified.
